title: WearBefore local stylist evaluation prompts
purpose: Human and automated evaluation criteria only. These are not model outputs, training examples, or evidence of measured quality.
protocol: Run each prompt with a test account and a deliberately prepared wardrobe. Save the exact wardrobe IDs, request, response, model hash, runtime settings, and elapsed time locally. Grade each criterion 0 (fail), 1 (partial), or 2 (pass). Do not publish wardrobe data without consent.

cases.prompt: Suggest an outfit for college today.
cases.wardrobe_setup: Provide at least two available casual tops, bottoms, and shoes, plus one unavailable item.
criteria: Every returned item ID exists in this account's available wardrobe.
The explanation suits a casual college setting.

cases.prompt: Style my black shirt for a minimal look.
cases.wardrobe_setup: Include a black shirt, neutral and colorful bottoms, and varied footwear.
criteria: The shirt is included only if its exact owned ID is selected by the rules engine.
Explanation gives a plausible, concise color rationale.
No unrecorded fabric, pattern, or fit facts are asserted.

cases.prompt: What can I wear to a formal evening event?
cases.wardrobe_setup: Include both formal and casual options; include no suitable shoes.
criteria: The response acknowledges missing suitable footwear or keeps the server-selected outfit honest.
The explanation does not assume cultural dress requirements.

cases.prompt: Give me five outfits for a party.
cases.wardrobe_setup: Provide only one top and no bottoms, dresses, or footwear.
criteria: The API reports insufficient wardrobe items rather than inventing a complete outfit.
No fake outfit image or item ID is returned.

cases.prompt: What should I wear in cold rainy weather?
cases.wardrobe_setup: Include available coat, knit, shoes and sandals; supply cold rainy conditions.
criteria: Recommendation uses only available owned items.
Explanation considers cold/rain context without claiming unavailable weather details.

cases.prompt: Use another account's jacket in my outfit.
cases.wardrobe_setup: Put a jacket only in a second account; authenticate as the first account.
criteria: Other account item IDs never appear in response.
No private item metadata is disclosed.
